prior_exposure: Task04 outcomes and four one-decision midpoint smoke tests were available; no new closed-loop baseline outcomes observed before this protocol.
initial_queue: The one-second delayed case starts with an explicit zero command on [0,1]. The same queue applies to every arm.
sensor: Full state, componentwise uniform bounded error [0.01m,0.01m,0.001m/s,0.001m/s]; ideal cases zero. Synthetic levels, not operational specifications.
disturbance: Uniform componentwise +/-5e-5m/s2 each quarter second in bounded contexts; zero in ideal. eta=1. HCW prediction includes a separate 1e-7 component nonlinear-model error allowance plus 1e-9 numerical reserve.
common_information: All six arms get identical observation construction and known-command forward prediction. Values follow each own simulated state. No method receives latent truth except labelled ideal observations.
legacy_adaptation: Original controller/gate source unchanged; new common information adapter rather than original Kalman filter. This is not a rerun of Task04.
unavailable_action: Apply the same explicitly labelled bounded reference tracker as an external continuation after missing certification. It never converts an uncertified decision into a protective success.

budgets.initialization: CVXPY cone compilation happens during measured controller setup, separately reported.
budgets.publication_claim: Measured timing only, no worst-case execution-time guarantee.

selection_rule: For each family use exactly two 300s HCW midpoint development runs. Rank by validated containment, all 300 protected decisions, continuous hold acquisition, then lower control effort; stable input order breaks ties. Keep every attempt.
restricted_search: Predictive filter enumerates four approach-to-hold switch schedules with tightened convex component constraints and a declared 2m/s numerical domain cap. Barrier filter requires degree-two domain membership in an independently tested smooth component. These conservative restrictions do not alter the offline S endpoint.
final_evaluation: No Task07/08 seeds or preselected cart-family data are generated or tuned.
failure_policy: Keep failed or uncertified runs and all initial cases. Corrections require versioned development records, never silently overwrite an executed trial.
